chunks: Al-Sadiq عليه السلام was asked about the saying of Allah, Mighty and Majestic:
"Protect yourselves and your families from a Fire."

How do we protect them? He said: "You command them and forbid them." It was said to him: "We command them and forbid them, but they do not accept." He said: "When you have commanded them and forbidden them, then you have fulfilled what is upon you."

key_terms.أَنْفُسَكُمْ: Yourselves; your own persons and souls.
key_terms.أَهْلِيكُمْ: Your families; the members of your household.
key_terms.تَأْمُرُونَهُنَّ: You command them; instruct them to do what is right.
key_terms.تَنْهَوْنَهُنَّ: You forbid them; restrain and warn them from wrongdoing.
key_terms.قَضَيْتُمْ: You have fulfilled; discharged what was required.
key_terms.قُوا: Protect; guard against harm and punishment.
key_terms.مَا عَلَيْكُمْ: What is upon you; the duty and responsibility binding on you.
key_terms.نَاراً: A Fire; the punishment of Hell.

ai.seo_question: How do you protect your family from the Fire according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the verse by stating that protecting one's family from the Fire is done through commanding them toward what is right and forbidding them from what is wrong. It teaches that a person is responsible for sincere moral instruction and admonition, and once that duty is fulfilled, the burden of responsibility has been discharged.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4533 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) was asked about the saying of Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic:
"Protect yourselves and your families from a Fire" (Surah At-Tahrim, 66:6).

How do we protect them?
Imam (as) said: "You command them and forbid them."
It was said to him: "We command them and forbid them, but they do not accept."
Imam (as) said: "When you have commanded them and forbidden them, then you have fulfilled your responsibility."
